peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.5% below its local comparables; 73 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (90.9): 5.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 367 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 29.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,220,000 ($2,313 psf, 527–581 sq ft; 7 resales, Apr 2024–Mar 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,324 psf (range $1,697–2,763); 0.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $6,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Little India MRT about 320 m, Rochor MRT about 400 m; closer than 396 of 551 similar developments (the same as 6). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest ST. Margaret's School (Primary) about 340 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 390 m), more than 170 of 551 similar developments (the same as 41); nearest hawker centre Tekka Centre/Zhu Jiao Market about 420 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 100 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 160 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 190 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 290 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 960 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,030 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,190 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 1,310 m; Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 1,320 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 335 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 721 new sales and 1,088 resales (1,809 purchases); new sales were 39.9% of these purchases. Subsales (56) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 320 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,400 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,590 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,730 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,088 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 331 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,088 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,164 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.5%). Planning-area private resales −9.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
